purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Report Finalization & Sign-off' screen within workflow WF_001.
postconditions: All required fields on 'Report Finalization & Sign-off' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm an impression section is present before the report can be signed off
Confirm critical findings trigger the critical-result notification workflow before sign-off completes
Confirm the report cannot be amended after sign-off without a formal addendum
common_errors: Report signed off with an empty impression field
Critical finding flagged but notification not triggered
